title: New area? Has anyone been here?
content: I’ve only dreamt of mall world two times now. The first time I was in one location. It was a Disney store, but it was tailored for more adult women. They had princess tutus and short princess dresses. They’re really expensive dresses. The second time, which was last night, my dream started off in a landfill/pick n pull area. The sky was blue and had what looked like a really tall force field around it, next to the water. The sun was really bright, and I was with a group of people. They were looking for something and we walked for miles. When we reached the end of the landfill an older lady in a red car picked us up and drive us back to the entrance. Then I had to climb this wall with huge cement blocks to use as steps and it was covered in vines and algae. After I climbed over that I was inside the mall. And I went back inside the Disney store. It had some of the same dresses and a few new ones. I regrouped with my group and we spent the night in one of the levels of the mall. We some had guns and I had a flame thrower. Long story short we had to fight these gray/white looking beings with dark hair and red glowing eyes. My flame thrower worked once and then went out. That’s when I woke up. Does any of this sound familiar to anyone?
